purpose: To furnish a report on Corporate Social Responsibility to the Registrar for the preceding financial year and onwards.
who: Every company covered under the provisions of sub-section (1) to section 135
when: For 2020-2021 on or before 30th June 2022; for 2021-2022 on or before 31st March 2023; for 2022-2023 on or before 31st March 2024; for 2023-2024 on or before 30th June 2025
steps: Determine if the company is covered under sub-section (1) to section 135
File Form AOC-4 or AOC-4 XBRL or AOC-4 NBFC (Ind AS)
File Form CSR-2 as an addendum or separately depending on the financial year
checklist: Verify the company is covered under section 135
Complete the relevant AOC-4 form first
Check the applicable due date for the specific financial year
watch: Form CSR-2 must be filed after filing Form AOC-4, AOC-4 XBRL, or AOC-4 NBFC (Ind AS).
